arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Test with fixed values only
r = parse.Result(('spam', 'ham'), {}, None)
print('Fixed result:', r)
print('0 in r:', 0 in r)
print('1 in r:', 1 in r)
print('2 in r:', 2 in r)
print('spam in r:', 'spam' in r)
print('cheese in r:', 'cheese' in r)

# Test with named values only
r2 = parse.Result((), {'name': 'John', 'age': 42}, None)
print('\nNamed result:', r2)
print('name in r2:', 'name' in r2)
print('age in r2:', 'age' in r2)
print('email in r2:', 'email' in r2)
print('John in r2:', 'John' in r2)
print('42 in r2:', 42 in r2)

# Test with both
r3 = parse.Result(('a', 'b'), {'x': 'c'}, None)
print('\nMixed result:', r3)
print('0 in r3:', 0 in r3)
print('x in r3:', 'x' in r3)
print('a in r3:', 'a' in r3)
print('c in r3:', 'c' in r3)
"
